name: Extract Decisions and Action Items from Multi-Page Meeting Minutes to Google Sheets (LDX hub Accordion Pipeline)

parameters.formDescription: Upload multi-page meeting minutes as a PDF. LDX hub splits the document into agenda segments and extracts every decision and action item into Google Sheets — one row per item.

parameters.system_prompt:
You are given meeting minutes that may span many pages. Split the document into one item per agenda topic.

Rules:
- Cover the entire document: every agenda topic becomes exactly one item, in document order.
- An agenda topic may continue across page boundaries — keep it as one single item; never split a topic by page and never merge different topics.
- agenda_no: the topic number as written in the document (integer). If topics are unnumbered, use the 1-based position.
- agenda_title: the topic heading as written.
- content: the full text of that topic's section, transcribed faithfully in the original language (do not summarize, translate, or omit anything). Keep all decisions, action items, owners, and deadlines exactly as written.
- Do not include the meeting header (title, date, attendees) or page headers/footers in any item's content.

The input text is one agenda segment from meeting minutes. The first line is a header in the form "[Agenda N] Title". Extract every decision and every action item from the segment.

Rules:
- agenda_no / agenda_title: copy from the header line (agenda_no as an integer).
- items: one element per decision or action item found in the text. Return an empty array if there are none.
- item_type: "decision" for decisions and agreements, "action" for tasks someone has to do.
- item: the decision or task itself, in the original language, without the owner and deadline parts.
- owner: the responsible person or team as written; "" if not stated.
- due_date: the deadline in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD) when an exact date is given; otherwise copy the deadline expression as written (e.g. "next meeting"); "" if none.

parameters.content:
## Accordion Pipeline: Meeting Minutes → Action Items
Upload multi-page meeting minutes (PDF) via the built-in form. Stage 1 — **LDX hub AnalyzeDoc** reads the whole document and splits it into agenda segments *by meaning* (a topic that crosses a page boundary stays in one piece). Stage 2 — **LDX hub StructFlow** extracts every decision and action item from each segment. One document in, N rows out.

**Setup**
1. Install the verified community node `n8n-nodes-ldxhub` (v0.10.0 or later) and create an **LDXhub API** credential — get a free API key at https://gw.portal.ldxhub.io (25,000 credits/month, no credit card).
2. Create a Google Sheet with this header row:
`agenda_no, agenda_title, item_type, item, owner, due_date`
3. In **Append Rows to Google Sheets**, select your Google credential, spreadsheet, and sheet.
4. After picking the sheet, set Mapping Column Mode back to **Map Automatically** — n8n switches it to manual when a sheet is selected.
5. Activate the workflow, open the form URL, and upload the minutes.

Note: one run executes two AI jobs (segmenter + extractor).

## The accordion convention
Stage 1 must return `{"items": [...]}` — the Code node between the stages expands that array into one record per element. Keep the `items` key and this template adapts to any long document: contracts (one item per clause), papers (per section), reports (per chapter). Just edit the two prompts and Example Outputs.
